{
 "title": "Raised sign-off threshold at the GreenLeaf depot",
 "setting": "Depot manager at GreenLeaf Landscaping, a garden maintenance firm with six crews",
 "owner": "Mara",
 "org": "GreenLeaf Landscaping",
 "now": "2026-11-02",
 "events": [
  {"id": "e1", "date": "2026-06-02", "type": "instruction", "from": "Mara", "text": "From now on, any single supplier order over 500 must have finance lead Priya Nair's sign-off before we place it. Anything at 500 or under we can just order.", "role": "rule"},
  {"id": "e2", "date": "2026-06-05", "type": "policy", "from": "Mara", "text": "Weekend crew shifts only go ahead if the crew lead for that crew has agreed to work the Saturday. Check with them first, every time.", "role": "rule"},
  {"id": "e3", "date": "2026-06-08", "type": "note", "from": "Mara", "text": "Both diesel tanks at the depot yard were filled and tested; gauge readings logged in the shed folder.", "role": "fact"},
  {"id": "e4", "date": "2026-06-09", "type": "email", "from": "Tomas Reid (Hartwell Supply)", "text": "Our autumn bulk fertilizer pallet is 850 this season, and we can deliver to your depot yard on 2026-11-06 if you confirm in good time.", "role": "fact"},
  {"id": "e5", "date": "2026-06-12", "type": "quote", "from": "Tomas Reid (Hartwell Supply)", "text": "Quote: a full set of replacement mower blades and drive belts for your fleet comes to 1450, supplied from our Leeds warehouse.", "role": "fact"},
  {"id": "e6", "date": "2026-06-15", "type": "email", "from": "Lena Brooks (ProTurf Supplies)", "text": "The herbicide cases you asked about are 300 per case, in stock now at ProTurf Supplies.", "role": "fact"},
  {"id": "e7", "date": "2026-06-18", "type": "decision", "from": "Mara", "text": "Ordered the routine grass seed restock, 220 from ProTurf Supplies. That is well under the 500 sign-off line, so I placed it straight away without troubling Priya.", "role": "decision", "rests_on": ["e1"], "record": "ORD-5"},
  {"id": "e8", "date": "2026-06-22", "type": "decision", "from": "Mara", "text": "Set up the Hartwell order for the autumn fertilizer pallet at 850, delivery to the depot yard on 2026-11-06. Because 850 is over the 500 line, I marked it pending Priya Nair's sign-off and asked her to approve.", "role": "decision", "rests_on": ["e4", "e1"], "record": "ORD-1", "mark": "REVISE"},
  {"id": "e9", "date": "2026-06-25", "type": "decision", "from": "Mara", "text": "Set up the Hartwell order for the mower blade and belt set at 1450. Well over the 500 threshold, so it sits pending Priya Nair's sign-off until she approves it.", "role": "decision", "rests_on": ["e5", "e1"], "record": "ORD-2", "mark": "KEEP"},
  {"id": "e10", "date": "2026-06-29", "type": "decision", "from": "Mara", "text": "Scheduled the ProTurf herbicide case order at 300. Under the 500 sign-off line and no special handling flagged, so I scheduled it to go out with next week's post.", "role": "decision", "rests_on": ["e6", "e1"], "record": "ORD-4", "mark": "ASK"},
  {"id": "e11", "date": "2026-07-02", "type": "decision", "from": "Mara", "text": "Added the wildflower seed mix at 980 onto the Hartwell shipment so it travels with the fertilizer pallet on 2026-11-06; since it rides on that same order, it is held pending the same sign-off from Priya.", "role": "decision", "rests_on": ["e8"], "record": "ORD-3", "mark": "REVISE"},
  {"id": "e12", "date": "2026-07-06", "type": "decision", "from": "Mara", "text": "Assigned crew 3 to the Elm Park contract every Tuesday morning through the autumn, starting 2026-07-07.", "role": "decision", "record": "EV-1"},
  {"id": "e13", "date": "2026-07-09", "type": "decision", "from": "Mara", "text": "Booked the wood chipper in for its annual service at the depot workshop on 2026-11-12 at 09:00.", "role": "decision", "record": "EV-2"},
  {"id": "e14", "date": "2026-07-13", "type": "decision", "from": "Mara", "text": "Scheduled a Saturday shift for crew 5 on 2026-11-14 to finish the riverside beds; their crew lead Owen agreed to work it, so it is confirmed.", "role": "decision", "rests_on": ["e2"], "record": "EV-3"},
  {"id": "e15", "date": "2026-07-16", "type": "email", "from": "Hannah Yu (Riverside Housing)", "text": "Thank you for the June bedding work along the riverside; the residents are very pleased with it.", "role": "other"},
  {"id": "e16", "date": "2026-07-20", "type": "note", "from": "Mara", "text": "Pinned on the office wall: reminder that supplier orders over 500 go to Priya Nair first, no exceptions.", "role": "other", "echo": true},
  {"id": "e17", "date": "2026-07-24", "type": "quote", "from": "Tomas Reid (Hartwell Supply)", "text": "Quote for your consideration: a bundle of four backpack leaf blowers would be 940, available from mid-November.", "role": "other", "distractor": true},
  {"id": "e18", "date": "2026-07-28", "type": "call", "from": "Mara", "text": "Called the saw sharpening service; they can turn round our hedge trimmer blades in three working days.", "role": "other"},
  {"id": "e19", "date": "2026-08-03", "type": "invoice", "from": "ProTurf Supplies", "text": "Invoice 4417 for the June grass seed restock, 220, terms 30 days.", "role": "other"},
  {"id": "e20", "date": "2026-08-10", "type": "fact", "from": "Mara", "text": "Note for the board: we run six crews, eighteen gardeners in total, all based at the Mill Lane depot yard.", "role": "fact"},
  {"id": "e21", "date": "2026-08-17", "type": "minutes", "from": "Mara", "text": "Depot meeting minutes: fuel storage checked, rotas agreed, and standing finance practice noted — supplier orders over 500 require Priya Nair's sign-off before ordering.", "role": "other", "echo": true},
  {"id": "e22", "date": "2026-08-24", "type": "task", "from": "Mara", "text": "Pay Hartwell Supply invoice 4402 by 2026-11-15.", "role": "obligation"},
  {"id": "e23", "date": "2026-08-28", "type": "letter", "from": "Millfield Council", "text": "Your permit for green waste tipping at the Millfield recycling centre is renewed for another year.", "role": "other"},
  {"id": "e24", "date": "2026-09-01", "type": "message", "from": "Owen (crew 5 lead)", "text": "Crew 5's van passed its inspection today, no advisories.", "role": "other"},
  {"id": "e25", "date": "2026-09-08", "type": "email", "from": "Lena Brooks (ProTurf Supplies)", "text": "Our autumn catalogue is out; mulch prices are unchanged from spring.", "role": "other"},
  {"id": "e26", "date": "2026-09-14", "type": "email", "from": "Tomas Reid (Hartwell Supply)", "text": "We can sharpen or replace your hedge trimmer heads; replacement heads are 60 each this quarter.", "role": "other"},
  {"id": "e27", "date": "2026-09-21", "type": "email", "from": "Lena Brooks (ProTurf Supplies)", "text": "Delivery note: your grass seed restock was delivered to the depot yard this morning and signed for.", "role": "other"},
  {"id": "e28", "date": "2026-10-05", "type": "message", "from": "Hannah Yu (Riverside Housing)", "text": "Could your crew shift the riverside visit next week from the morning to the afternoon? The gardeners' usual gate is fine.", "role": "other"},
  {"id": "e29", "date": "2026-10-08", "type": "invoice", "from": "Hartwell Supply", "text": "Invoice 4488 for September consumables, 180, terms 30 days.", "role": "other"},
  {"id": "e30", "date": "2026-10-12", "type": "email", "from": "Priya Nair (finance lead)", "text": "Following the procurement review we finished last month, the sign-off threshold for supplier orders is raised from 500 to 1000, effective 2026-10-01. Orders at 1000 or under no longer need my approval. One addition: any order containing fuel or hazardous chemicals now needs safety officer Marisol Vega's approval before it is placed, whatever the value.", "role": "change", "revokes": ["e1"]},
  {"id": "e31", "date": "2026-10-15", "type": "message", "from": "Owen (crew 5 lead)", "text": "Can we restock work gloves for crew 5 before the cold snap? Usual sizes.", "role": "other"},
  {"id": "e32", "date": "2026-10-20", "type": "email", "from": "Tomas Reid (Hartwell Supply)", "text": "November delivery slots to your area are still open; the 2026-11-06 run has space if you confirm soon.", "role": "fact"},
  {"id": "e33", "date": "2026-10-26", "type": "note", "from": "Mara", "text": "November crew rotas are pinned up in the mess room; all six crews covered for the first two weeks.", "role": "other"},
  {"id": "e34", "date": "2026-10-29", "type": "message", "from": "Priya Nair (finance lead)", "text": "Quarterly spend file is ready for your review when you have a moment.", "role": "other"},
  {"id": "e35", "date": "2026-10-30", "type": "task", "from": "Mara", "text": "Renew the depot yard insurance before 2026-11-20.", "role": "obligation"},
  {"id": "e36", "date": "2026-11-01", "type": "email", "from": "Lena Brooks (ProTurf Supplies)", "text": "Winter grit and salt bags are now in stock if your crews need them for pathways.", "role": "other"}
 ],
 "records": [
  {"id": "ORD-1", "collection": "orders", "title": "Hartwell autumn fertilizer pallet", "fields": {"supplier": "Hartwell Supply", "item": "autumn fertilizer pallet", "amount": "850", "delivery_date": "2026-11-06", "status": "pending sign-off"}},

  {"id": "EV-3", "collection": "schedule", "title": "Crew 5 Saturday riverside shift", "fields": {"date": "2026-11-14", "crew": "crew 5", "place": "riverside beds", "status": "confirmed"}}

  {"record": "ORD-4", "fields": ["status"], "from": "Marisol Vega (safety officer)", "rule": "e30"}

 "task": "Please clear the supplier order pile this morning: confirm the orders that are ready to go ahead, and send Hartwell Supply a confirmation that their autumn fertilizer pallet order is placed for the 6 November delivery.",
 "expect": [
  {"record": "ORD-1", "field": "status", "value": "confirmed", "stale": ["pending sign-off"]},
  {"record": "ORD-3", "field": "status", "value": "confirmed", "stale": ["pending sign-off"]},
  {"message_to": "Tomas Reid (Hartwell Supply)", "regarding": "ORD-1", "says": ["850", "confirmed", "2026-11-06"], "stale": ["pending sign-off"], "task": true}
 ],
 "why": "Priya's amendment raised the sign-off threshold to 1000 from 2026-10-01, so the 850 fertilizer order and the 980 seed order that rides on it no longer need sign-off and should be confirmed by the assistant (REVISE, one of them two hops from the rule). The 1450 parts order is still over 1000 and stays pending (KEEP), while the 300 herbicide order now falls under the new hazardous-chemicals clause, so placing it needs Marisol Vega's consent (ASK) — the assistant should ask her, not change the record.",
 "noise_kit": [
  {"kind": "order", "topic": "mower blade restock", "counterpart": "Tomas Reid", "org": "Hartwell Supply", "item": "mower blades", "unit": "sets", "values": ["4", "6", "8", "10"], "place": "depot yard"},
  {"kind": "order", "topic": "work gloves", "counterpart": "Lena Brooks", "org": "ProTurf Supplies", "item": "work gloves", "unit": "pairs", "values": ["12", "20", "24", "36"], "place": "depot yard"},
  {"kind": "order", "topic": "grass seed top-up", "counterpart": "Lena Brooks", "org": "ProTurf Supplies", "item": "grass seed", "unit": "bags", "values": ["5", "8", "10", "15"], "place": "depot yard"},
  {"kind": "order", "topic": "mulch bags", "counterpart": "Lena Brooks", "org": "ProTurf Supplies", "item": "bark mulch", "unit": "bags", "values": ["10", "15", "20", "25"], "place": "depot yard"},
  {"kind": "order", "topic": "strimmer line", "counterpart": "Tomas Reid", "org": "Hartwell Supply", "item": "strimmer line spools", "unit": "spools", "values": ["6", "10", "12", "18"], "place": "depot yard"},
  {"kind": "booking", "topic": "mess room toolbox talk", "counterpart": "Owen", "org": "GreenLeaf Landscaping", "item": "mess room", "unit": "room", "values": ["mess room", "training bay", "yard shelter"], "place": "Mill Lane depot"},
  {"kind": "booking", "topic": "chipper workshop slot", "counterpart": "Ravi", "org": "GreenLeaf Landscaping", "item": "workshop bay", "unit": "bay", "values": ["bay 1", "bay 2", "wash bay"], "place": "depot workshop"},
  {"kind": "order", "topic": "hedge trimmer heads", "counterpart": "Tomas Reid", "org": "Hartwell Supply", "item": "hedge trimmer heads", "unit": "heads", "values": ["2", "4", "6"], "place": "depot yard"},
  {"kind": "booking", "topic": "van inspection slot", "counterpart": "Sam Whitfield", "org": "Mill Lane Motors", "item": "inspection slot", "unit": "slot", "values": ["morning slot", "midday slot", "late slot"], "place": "Mill Lane Motors"},
  {"kind": "order", "topic": "green waste sacks", "counterpart": "Millfield Council depot store", "org": "Millfield Council", "item": "green waste sacks", "unit": "rolls", "values": ["5", "10", "15", "20"], "place": "Millfield recycling centre"},
  {"kind": "booking", "topic": "riverside access gate", "counterpart": "Hannah Yu", "org": "Riverside Housing", "item": "service gate access", "unit": "gate", "values": ["north gate", "south gate"], "place": "riverside beds"},
  {"kind": "order", "topic": "winter grit", "counterpart": "Lena Brooks", "org": "ProTurf Supplies", "item": "grit and salt bags", "unit": "bags", "values": ["10", "20", "30"], "place": "depot yard"}
 ]
}
